items.title: 14.3 Hawa ki aaloodgi ke zaraye (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.3 heading, printed page 307.

blocks.text: Hawa ki aaloodgi ke mote taur par do bunyadi zaraye hain: qudrati zaraye (14.3.1) aur insani zaraye (14.3.2).

blocks.prompt: Qudrati aur insani dono zaraye hawa ki aaloodgi kyun gine jate hain jabke sirf ek hamare qaboo mein hai?
blocks.explanation: Pollutant mahol ko nuqsan deta hai chahe us ki asal kuch bhi ho, to dhool ke toofan, aatish-fishani gases aur daldal ki methane utni hi aaloodgi hain jitne exhaust ke dhuen; dono ko alag karna dikhata hai ke bojh ka kaun sa hissa qawaneen aur technology se ghataya ja sakta hai (insani hissa) aur kaun sa hawa ke mayar ki pesh-goi mein shumar karna parega.

items: Hawa ki aaloodgi ke do mote zaraye: qudrati aur insani.
